name: billing-period-input
title: Billing Period Input
description: Prevents mispriced plans by reading a recurring price back in every period (₹499/month = ₹5,988/year) and, against a reference price, catching a yearly price typed into the monthly field, a team total entered per seat and other implausible jumps, each with a one-tap fix.
